commits.subject: P-cluster: reduce principal-degree-zero to residue-degree-one
commits.summary:
**Degree bridge.** `degK_eq_degree_of_residueDeg_eq_one`: the residue-weighted $\deg_k$ collapses to the geometric $\sum_P D(P)$ exactly when $[\kappa(P):k]=1$ on the support. Composed with `degK_principal_eq_zero` this gives `degree_principal_eq_zero_of_residueDeg_eq_one` — the UNWEIGHTED principal-degree-zero statement, proved from the closed ledger plus residue-degree-one.

**Effect on the open leaf.** The reduction of `WeilDivisor.principal_degree_zero` is now machine-checked rather than asserted in prose. Its whole residue is two items, neither about divisor theory: (1) $[\kappa(P):\bar k]=1$ for a prime divisor of a smooth curve over an algebraically closed base; (2) instance plumbing from the geometric hypotheses to the adelic ones.

**The `sorry` is left in place deliberately.** Substituting the new theorem would require the closed ledger for a cover of $C$, which is itself not yet a theorem here — that would relocate the gap while making a hypothesis-free statement depend silently on one. Recorded in section 4 of the module docstring.
